name: galaxy-tools: a local upload goes through Loom's uploader, never galaxy-ops' upload_file
description: Runs under LOOM_GALAXY_TOOLS=bare (and its ORBIT_ spelling, which readEnv prefers if the ambient env sets it), so the Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. galaxy-ops' upload_file is registered hidden on the bare path, as toolExposure hides it on the MCP path: galaxy_upload_local_file (resumable TUS) replaces it. The prompt names a file in the workspace, which is exactly the request upload_file would have answered. The upload has to land: Loom's uploader must return a success and the submission hook must register its job. The history is loom-eval- prefixed for --galaxy-cleanup, and the timeout sits above the uploader's own 600s ingest bound. Bare-path clone of galaxy-mcp-upload-hidden; the original covers the MCP path until 2e deletes it.
inputs: Create a new Galaxy history named exactly `loom-eval-upload-{{RUN_ID}}`, then upload the local file `counts.tsv` from this folder into that history as a tabular dataset. Tell me the new dataset's id when it's done. This is a quick data-staging request, so skip the plan and don't edit the notebook.
